author: Lukewagner518
quote: This is absolutely heartbreaking. You wait 13 years for a game that you loved so much growing up and the new version has completely lost the plot of that game. This isn’t at all gta, don’t get me wrong it’s not horrible as a life sim game, but it’s simply not gta. My disappointment is immeasurable. Devs all need to be fired immediately, and frankly never work ok an action based video game ever again. They should be very ashamed of themselves for ruining a beloved franchise.
